system.description:
Microbots can be outfitted with diamond “snippers” or jaws. While ideal for cutting wires, they may also be used to attack. A swarmanoid equipped with jaws can swarm a target, causing 1d10 + 1 DV with each successful attack (see Swarmanoid Attacks, next column). A single microbot is ineffective against small or larger targets, unless it has lots of time.

Source: Eclipse Phase Transhuman, p. 214.
